lines.text: What if you just... stopped sleeping?
Day one. You feel totally fine. Kind of proud, actually.
lines.label: DAY 1

lines.text: Day three. Your brain starts switching off for seconds at a time. Without asking you.
lines.label: DAY 3

lines.text: Day five. You start seeing things that aren't there.
lines.label: DAY 5

lines.text: Because here's the thing. Your body always wins. Sleep is not optional.
